title: salting wounds
author: Naarel
description:
Humanity regained its long lost spark of divinity. As this happened, new diseases started to emerge. You're a freshly appointed anthroflorist and your task is making sure that more flowery illnesses stay under control.

It's your first appointment with someone with apollinaria sanguinis and you've never been told how rough these can be.

[This project contains excessive mentions of blood and mild body horror. Proceed with caution.]
